refnamediv.refpurpose: Upsample, filter, and downsample a signal.

listitem.para: Output signal after upsampling, filtering, and downsampling.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `upfirdn` function performs three operations on the input signal `xin`: 1. Upsampling by a factor `p` (inserting zeros between samples). 2. Filtering the upsampled signal using the filter coefficients `h`. 3. Downsampling the filtered signal by a factor `q` (keeping every q-th sample).
